audience: contractors and operations teams tracking crews in Workyard

useCases.title: Check who is clocked in
useCases.text: List working time cards and match employee IDs to crew names before checking current staffing.

useCases.title: Review submitted time cards
useCases.text: Find submitted time cards for a date range, inspect their details and read activity segments before a payroll review.

useCases.title: Find projects and work sites
useCases.text: Look up projects, find their geofences and check which projects are attached to a work site.

useCases.title: Approve a reviewed time card
useCases.text: Approve one specific time card after reviewing its details. Approval feeds payroll and may not be reversible through the API.

useCases.title: Add context to a time card
useCases.text: Add a note to a specific time card to record a correction explanation or a supervisor check. Each call creates a new note.
